svg.aria-label: Registers hold one frame each for 16 pixels; after the network each register holds one rank
svg.text: Every SIMD lane sorts its own pixel
Register k holds frame k for 16 pixels (AVX-512, float32). The network min/maxes whole registers, so all 16 stacks sort at once, with no branches.
after the network: register k = rank k
outlined: one lane = one pixel's 9 frames (with a cosmic ray)
the median is register 4, already in place for all 16 pixels
